<issue>
LatentStyle quick_style property inverts boolean values

#### Description

When setting the `quick_style` property on a `_LatentStyle` object, boolean values are being inverted. Setting `quick_style = True` results in the underlying XML attribute being set to false, and vice versa.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx.styles.latent import _LatentStyle

# Create a latent style instance (assuming proper setup)
latent_style = _LatentStyle(element)

# Setting quick_style to True should set qFormat to true in XML
latent_style.quick_style = True
# But the actual XML shows qFormat="0" (false) instead of qFormat="1" (true)

# Setting quick_style to False should set qFormat to false in XML  
latent_style.quick_style = False
# But the actual XML shows qFormat="1" (true) instead of qFormat="0" (false)
```

The expected behavior is that `quick_style = True` should result in `qFormat="1"` in the XML, and `quick_style = False` should result in `qFormat="0"`.
</issue>
